jd:
Recruitment Specialist

About us: Northwind Staffing is a growing regional agency. We offer private health insurance and 25 days of leave.

Responsibilities:
- Manage end-to-end hiring for engineering roles.
- Screen CVs and run structured phone interviews.
- Maintain candidate records in the applicant tracking system.

Requirements:
- Five years of recruitment experience.
- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or Business Administration.
- CIPD certification is mandatory.
- Proficiency in Excel and ATS tools.
- Fluent English and Arabic.
- Strong communication and attention to detail.

Nice to have:
- LinkedIn Recruiter
- Knowledge of the staffing industry

Must have a valid work permit. Successful candidates will undergo a background check.
